description: Source code for managing and iterating over reftable data structures, including parsing footer, initializing and iterating over blocks and records, and handling references within a reftable database.

classes.name: struct table_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing records within a reftable table, managing current block, position, and iteration state.

methods.name: table_offsets_for
methods.description: Returns the offsets structure for a given block type within a reftable table.

methods.name: reftable_table_hash_id
methods.description: Returns the hash algorithm identifier used by the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the reftable.

methods.name: parse_footer
methods.description: Parses the footer of a reftable file to initialize table parameters and validate integrity.

methods.name: table_iter_init
methods.description: Initializes a table iterator for traversing records of a specific type.

methods.name: table_iter_next_in_block
methods.description: Retrieves the next record within the current block during iteration.

methods.name: table_iter_block_done
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the current block in iteration.

methods.name: table_init_block
methods.description: Initializes a block within the table at a specified offset and type.

methods.name: table_iter_close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a table iterator.

methods.name: table_iter_next_block
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next block in the table.

methods.name: table_iter_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next record of the specified type from the table.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_to
methods.description: Seeks the iterator to a specific offset and type.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_start
methods.description: Seeks to the start position for iteration, optionally to an index.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_linear
methods.description: Performs a linear seek within the current table to find a specific record.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_indexed
methods.description: Performs a seek using the index structure to locate a record.

methods.name: table_iter_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific record within the table, using index if available.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_void
methods.description: Void pointer version of seek function for generic iterator use.

methods.name: table_iter_next_void
methods.description: Void pointer version of next function for generic iterator use.

methods.name: table_iter_close_void
methods.description: Void pointer version of close function for generic iterator use.

methods.name: iterator_from_table_iter
methods.description: Creates a reftable_iterator from a table_iter.

methods.name: reftable_table_new
methods.description: Creates a new reftable object from a source, reading header and footer, and initializing internal structures.

methods.name: reftable_table_incref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a reftable.

methods.name: reftable_table_decref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and releases resources if count reaches zero.

methods.name: reftable_table_refs_for
methods.description: Retrieves references for a given object ID, using index if present.

methods.name: reftable_table_max_update_index
methods.description: Returns the maximum update index of the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_min_update_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum update index of the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a table iterator.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_next
methods.description: Advances the table iterator to the next block.
